title: Finite Arithmetic Capacity under Additive Locally Constant, Good-Reduction Multiplier, and Algebraic-Action Readouts

claims.statement: If each distinct exact hit prime admits log p = v_p + log q_p + alpha_p with v_p in one finite-dimensional rational space V, q_p positive algebraic with q_p squared supported on one fixed finite rational-prime set S, and alpha_p real algebraic, then the number of distinct hit primes is at most dim_Q(V)+|S|.
claims.scope: exact equality; real logarithm; rational additive normal form; fixed target-independent V and S
claims.evidence_type: deductive Hermite--Lindemann and finite-place valuation proof

claims.statement: The capacity proof needs no prior finiteness of the hit set and handles arbitrary preselected valid certificates, repeated hits, q=1, and negative or rational multiplier powers.
A fixed finite-memory locally constant periodic readout lies in one finite-dimensional rational span after higher-block recoding.
claims.scope: finite alphabet, fixed finite memory, fixed finite collection of architectures; excludes general Holder roofs

claims.statement: For the declared finite compositions of monic area-preserving generalized Henon factors, periodic coordinates are algebraic and integral away from fixed bad places, and each squared return-multiplier modulus is an S-unit.
claims.scope: fixed good-reduction architecture and saturated finite rational-prime support; squared modulus, not multiplier logarithm algebraicity
claims.evidence_type: projective no-infinity, non-Archimedean maximum, integral monodromy, and normal-extension proof

claims.statement: Regular evaluation of a single-valued Qbar-rational exact potential on an algebraic finite orbit gives an algebraic action; the general stepwise gauge shift includes both endpoints and all constants.
claims.scope: regular finite evaluation; algebraic declared operations; canonical gauge invariance requires endpoint compatibility
claims.evidence_type: finite algebraic evaluation and exact telescoping identity

claims.statement: A selector choosing one L, M, or A source embeds in the additive normal form and inherits the same rank-plus-support bound.
claims.scope: selector is a corollary, not the primary theorem

claims.statement: Exceeding the bound forces failure of at least one certificate hypothesis, but the listed exits are neither exclusive, exhaustive for arbitrary dynamics, nor sufficient for arithmetic provenance.
claims.scope: contraposition within the declared certificate only

claims.statement: The source-locked official audit passed nine exact/static gates and 51 tests while running no numerical candidate, computing no target match, and accessing no prime table, target array, or Riemann-zero data.
claims.scope: implementation and provenance integrity only; static outputs do not prove the mathematical theorem
claims.evidence_type: registered result, JUnit, independent deployment review, and exclusive result manifest

positive_outside_boundary: Deninger arithmetic-scheme systems are infinite-dimensional and attach periodic packets to closed points
Connes--Consani scaling and adele-class architectures carry prime places intrinsically and exhibit prime-indexed periods
explicit_nonclaims: no universal symplectic or arithmetic no-go theorem
no complete or sufficient escape trichotomy
no result for algebraic-irrational coefficients on multiplier logarithms
no Riemann-zero, zeta, determinant, trace-formula, quantization, or Route-B progress claim
no claim that the static audit itself proves Hermite--Lindemann, valuation theory, or the all-period source certificates
